freePlan.limits: Up to 5 users, 1 inbox, 1 Docs (knowledge base) site, 100 contacts/month

keyLimits.en: Up to 25 users, 2 inboxes included (extra inboxes +$10/month), unlimited contacts, 150 basic workflows, 1 basic SLA policy
Up to 50 users, 5 inboxes included, 25 included light users, 500 advanced workflows, 2 advanced SLA policies
Unlimited users (10-seat minimum), 10 inboxes included, 50 included light users, unlimited workflows and SLA policies, advanced permissions, HIPAA compliance option

addOns.en: AI Answers add-on billed at $0.75 per resolution, with a 3-month free trial of unlimited resolutions.
Additional inboxes beyond a plan's included count cost +$10/month each.

cautions.en: Displayed per-user prices ($25/$45/$75) reflect an annual billing commitment; an explicit month-to-month rate and the stated ~16% annual discount were not both cleanly separated on the fetched page, so the true monthly-billed price may be higher.
The Pro plan requires a minimum of 10 seats even for a smaller team, which raises the effective entry cost of that tier.

capabilities.en: Unified shared inbox for email and other channels, with saved replies, snooze, and send-later scheduling.
AI-assisted message drafting, conversation recapping, and translation.
Beacon: an embeddable support widget combining live chat, self-service help content, and AI-powered answers.
Workflow automation for routing and organizing conversations, plus reporting on response time and team performance.

limitations.en: Free plan is capped at 1 inbox and 100 contacts/month, too small for most active support teams.
Advanced permissions and HIPAA compliance are reserved for the top Pro tier, which has a 10-seat minimum.

reason.en: Direct competitor in email/chat customer support with a similar shared-inbox model.
Larger-scale customer support platform competitor with a broader feature set.
Alternative helpdesk platform, more IT/ITSM oriented but overlapping on ticketing.

unknowns: Exact month-to-month (non-annual) per-user price was not clearly isolated from the annual price on the fetched pricing page.
Whether displayed USD prices include tax was not stated on the pricing page.
Full list of the '100+ tools' referenced as integrations was not itemized in this pass beyond Shopify.

conflicts.en: The seed data's pricingText listed Standard ~$25, Plus ~$38, Pro ~$63-65 per user/month, while the pricing page fetched in this session showed Standard $25, Plus $45, Pro $75. Kept the freshly fetched figures and flagged the discrepancy for review.
